title: Nik's Craftables - Pottery Sherds
description: Adds recipes to craft and duplicate pottery sherds.
body:
![purple text in the style of minecraft's logo that reads "CRAFTABLES"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eccdd03eda4eebaaf673eae9f78a289d03cc3314.png)

Adds recipes to craft and duplicate pottery sherds. Unlock recipes by completing certain tasks. For example, the angler pottery sherd recipe is obtained by catching a fish. Other recipes are unlocked by obtaining items, such as the blade pottery sherd recipe, which is obtained when you craft any sword.

![4 crafting tables in a 2x2 pattern with items placed on top in each block of the crafting table. Floating above those items are angler and blade pottery sherds](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/964e764a335713501a2a314092a3e52c7f640ace_0.webp)
